scope: Additional Host source/configuration metadata only; Java expected API channels/events/counters remain unchanged.
ModuleName inference is a bounded source specialization for this old input set, not a general URI parser/resolver.
Physical file bindings enumerate original declared source files only; no cache/source tree traversal or network.
Factory failures are actual authored Host IOException inputs; Pkl error text/frame generation remains shared engine responsibility.

NoLoader input is exact URI registry-miss membership from authenticated source literals + actual empty factory trace, only after shared default returns false. Other unconfigured URIs remain acquisition failures.
